en: Black‑and‑white photograph of an early–mid 20th‑century cargo ship at sea. The vessel is viewed from the side, showing its hull, deck structures, masts, cargo booms and funnel. Large painted letters on the hull read "GUDRUN MÆRSK". On the stern area, additional text includes the ship's name and a home port. A flag flies at the stern that appears to be the Danish flag (a Nordic cross). The overall style resembles a historical shipping postcard depicting a commercial vessel.
